say:2:1322075001:1.text: He secretly snuck out again! This is reckless!
say:2:1322075001:1.source_cn: 戴蒙他、他自己偷偷跑出门了……？太危险了！

say:3:1322075002:1.text: What if he gets hurt and sick in the wild?! Without Stitchy to protect him, what if he runs into bad people...?
say:3:1322075002:1.source_cn: 他在野外一定会受伤生病，没有奇奇保护他，万一遇到坏人……

say:4:1322075003:1.text: I have to go find him! Niru, we need to go right now!
say:4:1322075003:1.source_cn: 我要去找他，尼汝，我们……我们赶快去找他！

say:5:1322075004:1.text: Fear not. Let us scour the surroundings with care. The snow lies thick here. Even if Daimon slipped away, his footprints would surely mark his path.
say:5:1322075004:1.source_cn: 先别着急，我们在周围仔细检查一圈。这里是雪地，戴蒙就算...

say:7:1322075005:1.text: Don't panic, my love. We will definitely find him...
say:7:1322075005:1.source_cn: 吾爱，别慌，我们一定能找到他……
